newsitem.title: USA: Micros-to-Mainframes in merger talks. [CORRECTED 16:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Micros-to-Mainframes in merger talks. [CORRECTED 16:30 GMT]

text.p: Micros-to-Mainframes Inc said Monday it is negotiating to merge

The company posted a net income of $130,000 ($0.03 a share) on revenues of $17.6 million (corrects from $14.7 million) in its first quarter ended June 30, compared with a $256,000 net ($0.06 a share) on revenues of $13.3 million (corrects from $11.8 million) last year.
The company attributed the higher revenues primarily to to stronger sales of hardware and technology consulting to both new and existing customers.

Chairman Howard Pavony said in a statement higher selling, general and administrative expenses affected the company's bottom line but was "in keeping with our long-term strategy to accelerate the expansion of the high margin service and consulting business."
A company spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate on the possible merger deal.
The company's stock hit a new 52-week high of 6-1/8 Monday, and traded at 6 later in the morning, up 7/8.
